name: imagegen-route
description: Safely route Codex's bundled image-generation CLI through the active custom provider.

interface.shortDescription: Safe custom-provider routing for the Codex image CLI
interface.longDescription: Validate the selected Codex provider and inject its endpoint and local Codex credential only into the bundled image-generation CLI child process.
defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen-route to validate my custom image provider.
Use $imagegen-route for a path-only image generation run.
